The Floor is Lava! 🌋 Challenge your child to get both feet off the floor in 10 seconds. Count down: 10, 9, 8...
Animal Walk Race! 🦀 Have a race with your child, but tell them you both can only walk sideways like a crab!
Freeze Dance! 🕺 Play your child's favorite Bollywood song. When you pause it randomly, they must freeze like a statue!
The Wobbly Waiter! 🍽️ Put a plastic cup or small book on their head and ask them to walk from the bedroom to the kitchen without dropping it.
Jumping Jack Challenge! 🤸 Ask your child to see how many jumping jacks they can do while singing the ABCs or a Kannada rhyme.
Balloon Keep-Up! 🎈 Blow up a balloon and see how long you and your child can keep it from touching the ground.
Pillow Stepping Stones! ☁️ Place pillows on the floor and have your child jump from one to the next to cross the 'crocodile river'.
Frog Jumps! 🐸 Ask them to do 10 giant frog jumps across the living room, ribbiting as loud as they can!
The Couch Obstacle Course! 🛋️ Create a safe path: climb over the couch, crawl under the dining table, and touch the front door as fast as they can.
Penguin Waddle! 🐧 Put a small pillow or soft ball between your child's knees and ask them to waddle across the room without dropping it.
Mirror, Mirror! 🪞 Stand facing your child. Tell them they must copy every funny move and silly face you make!
Indoor Bowling! 🎳 Set up empty plastic water bottles and have your child roll a soft pair of socks or soft ball to knock them down.
The Tiptoe Ninja! 🥷 Challenge your child to walk through the whole house on their tiptoes without making a single sound.
Sticky Spider Web! 🕸️ Use some paper tape in a doorway and have your child try to throw rolled-up newspaper 'flies' through it!
Wheelbarrow Walk! 🛒 Hold your child's ankles safely while they walk on their hands across the room.
Bear Crawl Safari! 🐻 Ask your child to crawl on their hands and feet (not their knees!) around the house looking for hidden toys.
Book Balancing Act! 📚 Put a notebook on their head and see if they can sit down and stand back up without dropping it.
The Laundry Basket Toss! 🧺 Have your child roll up 5 pairs of socks and see how many they can throw into the laundry basket from far away.
Helicopter Spins! 🚁 Tell them to spin around with their arms out 5 times, then ask them to try and walk in a straight line!
Yoga Tree Pose Challenge! 🌳 Challenge your child to stand on one leg and put their hands together. Who can balance the longest without falling?
